purpose: Compile source-authorized action into readable moving-image causality instead of pose lists, hand-waving, static tableaux or slideshow coverage.

scope.seedance_compiler_rule: Keep the existing SD2 provider-facing prompt grammar unchanged; apply this contract before model-specific serialization.
scope.h3_compiler_rule: Use the H3-specific real-time, physics-first serialization below.

h3_execution_contract.must_show_both_sides: Write both the initiating action and the defender/target response; do not serialize only one body.
h3_execution_contract.force_vector_rule: State one intended force direction and explicitly forbid its reverse when reversal would change the story result.
h3_execution_contract.sound_anchor_rule: Each foot plant, cloth pull, weapon movement, contact and environment response must correspond to a visible event in causal order.
h3_execution_contract.reference_semantics: Omni reference images are semantic state anchors, not a guaranteed interpolation or exact first/last-frame transport.
h3_execution_contract.first_frame_strategy: For readable action, prefer a pre-contact or mid-motion first frame with a visible power path. Use exact-first-frame I2V only when the opening composition itself is mandatory; a static contact-result first frame is weak unless the prompt requires readable recoil and aftermath.
forbidden: palms meeting without an authorized strike or block

qa_contract.pre_generation: Full detailed prompt QA: canonical plot, dialogue, action, identity, wardrobe, map, props, sound, camera, incoming/outgoing continuity, force chain and terminal state.
qa_contract.post_generation: Technical QA plus basic plot/outcome presence only. Do not reopen fine-grained action-rationality or performance-detail review after generation unless the owner explicitly requests it.
qa_contract.owner_acceptance: The owner may accept media with named known limitations. Persist that disposition and stop automatic regeneration.
